//: Prompt registry config for the BiggiePockets review workflow.
gate_arm names the arm whose verdict is posted as the official approve /
request-changes review and whose prompt ALWAYS runs (in single-arm mode it is the
only pass). Every other arm is an experiment arm ('thesis-first'): it runs only
when a PR opts in via the biggiepockets-dual-arm label, over the same Codex
findings, so summary formats can be compared side by side. The experiment only
changes presentation, never the gate decision.
prompts/<name>.md are versioned templates; shared rule blocks live in
prompts/_shared/ and are injected via {{@path}} markers. Prompt versions are
derived from file content by scripts/resolve-prompts.sh, never listed here.
Operations: Roll = edit a prompt file (its derived version bumps). Apply = set
gate_arm or swap an arm's prompt (no version change). Split = add a new arm
entry + prompt file (it becomes an experiment arm). Merge = fold a variant into
another prompt file and remove the arm.
